applies_to: AGC-4 software 4.83.0 (Modbus tables revision I), genset (DG) application; mains and BTB variants share many addresses but are not covered.
summary: The AGC-4 is DEIF's paralleling and power-management genset controller. Modbus RTU runs on option H2 (RS-485) or H9 (RS-232), and Modbus TCP on the option N Ethernet card. This map covers the genset-variant AC measurements, energy and hour counters, DC supply readings, the running-mode flags, the status flags and the control command words used for remote start, stop, breaker and mode commands.

addressing.note: The tables give a 'Modbus address' that goes straight into the request, and also a 6-digit PLC address that is one higher (input register 501 = PLC 300502). Request 501 on the wire for generator voltage L1-L2.

source.title: AGC-4 Modbus tables
source.pages: Spreadsheet sheets 'Holding register (03;06;16)', 'Input register (04)' and 'Discrete input contact (02)', DG column

notes: The source is an Excel workbook. Each row has a scaling exponent x; the value is raw x 10^-x, so x=2 is scale 0.01. Units are as printed.

32-bit values: the tables mark every 32-bit register with data format ABCD (high word at the lower address); DEIF's AGC 150 Modbus server manual (4189341435, section 3.4) uses the same notation with that meaning.
Only rows marked for the DG (genset) application are listed. Mains and BTB controllers reuse the same addresses for mains or bus A values.

Left out: the configurable area 0-499 (contents set by the Modbus configurator), analogue and multi-input readings (meaning depends on configuration), CIO module inputs, alarm bits, EIC engine data, DAVR data, power-management data and the 208 command-flag coils. They are all in the workbook.
Parameters are read and written through address areas plus the parameter's USW address (for example holding 4000-5999 'values used'); see the Option H2/H9 document 4189341180.
Control command bit words read back 0; the live state of the command words can be read on input registers 642-655 (not listed).

integration.summary: Read input registers 501-527 and 538 with function 04 for generator values, 567-568 for DC supply, and 1019 for the active mode. Send commands by writing a word to holding register 5 or 6 with bit 0 set together with the command bit.
integration.enable: Fit option H2 (RS-485), H9 (RS-232) or option N (Ethernet). Serial settings are in parameters 7500-7520, listed in the AGC-4 parameter list 4189340688.
quirks: A command word is only accepted when bit 0 is also 1; write e.g. 0x0003 to holding 5 for remote start.
Addresses 0-499 on function 04 are a user-configurable copy area, not fixed data.
setup: Option H2 RS-485: 9600 or 19200 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
Option N: set the card's IP address with the option N configuration software; Modbus TCP port 502.
gotchas: Most AC values are scaled x1 (whole volts, amps, kW); check the scaling column before assuming tenths.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
